guardian.title: Price Guardian: a cheaper option
guardian.summary: Save an estimated {useSaving} if you return the item, or {ownSaving} including the optional purchase.
guardian.context: Same item and price, {months} months, starting {date}. Savings include forecast VAT.
guardian.reason: A lower upfront payment moves financing from band {fromBand} to {toBand}. The monthly coefficient changes from {fromFactor} to {toFactor}.
guardian.comparison: Your choice compared with the suggested upfront payment
guardian.useGross: Upfront + all rent, then return (estimated, including VAT)
guardian.buyoutGross: Optional purchase at the end (estimated, including VAT)
guardian.ownGross: Upfront + all rent + purchase (estimated, including VAT)
guardian.buyoutWarning: The suggested option's optional purchase is {amount} higher. Its full cost including purchase is still lower.
guardian.taxNote: VAT uses planned invoice dates. Actual issue dates can change tax. The 2027 VAT change in this demo is fictional.
guardian.scope: We checked zero upfront and financing-band boundaries without increasing your upfront payment or monthly rent. This is not a search of every possible price.
guardian.actionHelp: This only updates your draft. Review it, then save separately. It does not approve financing or reserve the item.
